info.syllabusName: Kinh Doanh tại Châu á (Asian Business and Management)
info.description: Asia, a complex and diverse region with more than half of the world's population, is expanding at a dramatic pace. Large corporate enterprises which contribute to the growth and development of the region are organised and management differently from the West. The probability of error can be minimised if the decision-making process is supported with an understanding of the business systems, management structure of the country undergoing considerations. "Doing Business in Asia" is a cross-discipline subject that combines academic and practical business experience into governance, leadership and risk management with an emphasis on Asia. The subject examines key elements and dynamics of the changing business environment in Asian countries, marketplace analysis, business system and management structure, business cultures and sustainable developments when considering doing business in Asia. The subject covers 9 Asian countries/areas including Japan, China,India,Korea,Singapore,Malaysia,Philippines,Thailand and Vietnam.
